authority: fable-advisor pre-committed decision tree (round 7). Branch FAIL was defined BEFORE the evidence arrived; no further consultation is required or permitted.
trigger: no statistic met the operating point (>=87% recall at <=7.5% FP) on adjudicated labels
finding: The S3 defect is INPAINT PLAUSIBILITY — a semantic property (can the surrounding content stand in for what the mesh lost?) — not a measurable geometric quantity. Both quantity-based and location-based statistics failed against labels of measured reliability.
mechanism_established: composite() computes `den`, the total available alpha per pixel, and passes it to _fill_holes, a push-pull inpainter blurring at 9/31/81 px. Where the camera looks past the mesh edge den collapses: small holes inpaint plausibly, medium holes emerge as smear/melt, large holes stay black. One cause, two visual symptoms.
why_quantity_failed: A clip judged GOOD typically has 12% of its ramp pixels uncovered and a largest unfillable hole of 76px radius (a quarter of frame width). The inpainter repairs enormous holes invisibly and sometimes botches smaller ones, so no threshold on hole SIZE separates them.
why_location_failed: Weighting the hole mask by spectral-residual salience made it WORSE, not better: best sal_weak_max = 24/39 recall at AUC 0.811, against weak_max = 26/39 at AUC 0.873 for plain coverage. The location hypothesis is refuted, at least under this saliency model.

label_reliability_measured.protocol: three independent raters, two of them fully blind with independent shuffles
label_reliability_measured.note: cleaning the labels moved AUC 0.79 -> 0.87, so label noise was real and material — but the operating point still failed. The adjudicated defect rate is 62% (39/24), not the 36.5% the operator's first audit reported.

attempts.statistic: image-space patch resemblance to either source under local search
largest unfillable hole (distance transform vs the 81px kernel)
hole-salience overlap (the one permitted new statistic)

what_a_revival_would_need: a learned or VLM-based defect detector trained on many more labelled clips — a research project, not a delivery task; or
an engine redesign that avoids holes BY CONSTRUCTION: camera paths frustum-constrained to the mesh so the view never leaves covered geometry. That is a different experiment, not a patch to this one.
preserved: relabel_registry/ (both blind passes, keys, agreement, adjudication key)
not_wasted: the 227-clip depth cache and the letterbox audit both came out of this work and the letterbox exclusion improved S2
PLAN_S3.json is frozen and valid against the 291-endpoint pool, so a future engine can render it unchanged
the fabrication principle was sharpened to an enforceable form because of this evidence
